newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-JAMES PASSES 1,000 IN TAME DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAMES PASSES 1,000 IN TAME DRAW.

text.p: Australia's three-day match against current English county championhsip leaders Glamorgan ended in a tame draw on Friday as the Welsh county never threatened their victory target of 333 in 58 overs.
After Australia declared at 217 for seven Glamorgan reached 211 for three before calling a halt after 50 overs.
Australia had resumed on 100 for five, 215 ahead, and made quick progress through Paul Reiffel, with 56, and Mathew Elliott, 37. Greg Blewett finished unbeaten on 50.
Glamorgan began brightly and Steve James and Hugh Morris forged a 96-run opening stand before Morris was caught behind for 42.

James, who hit 91 in the first innings, went on to become the first player to pass 1,000 first class runs for the English season before being caught for 79. Matthew Maynard reached 16,000 first class career en route to his 45 not out.
